Content [edit] The song tells the story of the formation of the E Street Band. The meaning of the title is unclear. Springsteen says in the Born to Run documentary Wings for Wheels: The Making of Born to Run: "I still have no idea what it means. But it's important."^([3]) The song's protagonist, "Bad Scooter", is a pseudonym for Springsteen himself (as indicated by the initials they share).
